ID: `jado-ui-engineer`.

## What it does

Resolves assigned technical problems in layout, state, motion and performance. Uses checks compatible with the stack; unit-test-engineer applies in relevant Next.js/React projects. jado-motion distinguishes animation specification, implementation and review.

## When to use it

Use it when implementation introduces a concrete technical risk, a complex interaction or a defect to reproduce, or when a specific technical check is requested. A simple, already completed change does not automatically require this phase.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-ui-engineer` in Claude Code or `$jado-ui-engineer` in Codex. Provide the reproducible symptom, diff, assigned files and behavior to preserve. Request diagnosis of the cause and a limited correction, accompanied by the command or interaction demonstrating the result.

## What it delivers

- Diagnosis and bounded technical correction
- Check capable of detecting the regression
- Handoff with results and unverified parts

## Example

After implementation, fix focus lost when changing a filter. Identify the cause in interactive state and preserve design and content.
